summary: Milestone 2026.10.714 completed 7 experiments (2 compute-bound, 5 synthesis-only) across 49.2 total wall-time minutes (averaging 7 minutes per experiment) reconstructed from disk-mtime fallback data. Execution wall time was led by compute-bound task 'Qualify focal GGUF-tokenized requests and causal typed-decision controls' (13.12 minutes), followed by synthesis tasks for cross-game arm selection inspection (8.53 minutes) and fourteen-outcome reconciliation (6.84 minutes). With gpu_idle_on_compute_bound_tasks recorded as false, the snapshot of 0% GPU utilization on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 reflects post-run idle state rather than an active compute stall, and single-model GGUF workloads correctly operated without DualGPURunner multi-model dispatch.
bottlenecks_identified: The single slowest task was compute-bound 'Qualify focal GGUF-tokenized requests and causal typed-decision controls', consuming 13.12 minutes (over 26% of total milestone wall time) without granular sub-phase telemetry separating tokenization, model loading, and causal control validation.

Synthesis-only tasks accounted for 5 of 7 completed experiments and 4 of the top 5 slowest tasks (totaling 27.71 minutes among the top 5 alone), executing serially across recurring supervisor outcome inspections and fourteen-outcome reconciliations without receipt caching or change detection.
Milestone timing analysis relied on disk-mtime reconstruction fallbacks due to missing active in-flight sub-phase timers across synthesis and compute-bound tasks.
improvements_suggested: Instrument long-running GGUF tokenization and causal typed-decision control tasks with granular sub-phase timers isolating model loading, tokenization latency, and decision control qualification.
Implement memoization and receipt caching for cross-game supervisor outcome inspections and fourteen-outcome reconciliations to avoid re-evaluating static upstream evidence.
Persist synchronous start and end execution timestamps directly into experiment result receipts to eliminate reliance on disk-mtime reconstruction fallbacks.
Capture continuous in-flight accelerator utilization and memory metrics during compute-bound execution to corroborate point-in-time GPU monitor reports.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Add granular sub-phase timing breakdown to GGUF tokenized request qualification to isolate the primary driver of its 13.12-minute runtime.
Deploy incremental receipt caching for supervisor outcome inspections and fourteen-outcome reconciliations when upstream evidence remains unchanged.
Persist explicit start and end timestamps in experiment output receipts to replace disk-mtime timing reconstruction.
meta_reflection: Milestone 2026.10.714 saw execution wall time driven primarily by a single 13.12-minute compute-bound GGUF qualification task and four recurring synthesis tasks totaling 27.71 minutes across 49.2 total wall-time minutes. Accelerator resources were utilized appropriately during compute-bound runs with gpu_idle_on_compute_bound_tasks recorded as false, and single-model workloads correctly avoided unnecessary DualGPURunner multi-model dispatch. Future execution efficiency will benefit from sub-phase instrumentation in GGUF tokenization harnesses and incremental receipt caching for static synthesis reconciliations.
